notes.title: Version 1.22
notes.notes:
Trained the model a little more
Fixed crash if input file don't exist
Put code for the App to stay Awake on Windows.

notes.title: Version 1.21
notes.notes:
There use to me a model for animation and one for Live footage, on this update there is only a model that does all, so there is no more model selection.
Fist try to fix Nvidia cards 5xxx

notes.title: Version 1.20
notes.notes:
New option to select directly the output FPS, without having to multiply values
Multiply output now support 3X 5X 6X 7X
New versions of the model for both Animation and Live Action
Update OnnxRuntime library, to see if fix some AMD cards.
Sadly TorchSharp still not updated to support 5XXX Nvidia cards, so it will not work on those cards yet. I'm looking for alternative solutions if they take to much time to make the update.
No more "Scene transition" option, the new model handle it.

notes.title: Version 1.15
notes.notes:
New models for animation and Live action.
Fixed small text bug where text was not showing if you selected multiple files.

notes.title: 22/04/2025 Update
notes.notes: Software have a new model under the hood. Will try to fix some bugs on the next update, I'm also already working on a new model for the next version,

notes.title: Version 1.17 version released.
notes.notes:
#New models
#Improved memory usage, should be faster.
#Fixed a lot of memory leaks.

For the next version will try to add some new options, plus some new languages for the app.

notes.title: Version 1.06 released.
notes.notes:
Version 1.06 of the application been released. 


 New model released.
 Can setup the ffmpeg path from the config window.
 Detect on FFMPEG if some codecs are avaiable, if so, appear on the GUI.
 If input is image sequence with alpha and output PNG senquence, it support alpha.
 Can export GIF (limited to 50fps).
 Changelog button inside the app.
 Bug Fix: Clean Queue on Cancel.
